visual_description: A heavy roll of natural brown burlap fabric sitting next to a white industrial bucket filled with wet plaster. The burlap shows a coarse, woven texture. One strip of burlap is shown partially dipped in the white plaster, appearing stiff and dripping slightly. This setup represents the traditional 'Field Jacket' method.

constraints.material: Coarse organic burlap fiber; matte white gypsum plaster.
constraints.background: Isolated on a 50% grey floor plane with soft contact shadows.
